method: open the port, wait until the line has been quiet for 0.5 s, send one byte, read for 5 s, count report headers (H lines); one run of the t27 player is 15200 bytes

old_player.rule: any falling edge of RX queues a start

fixed_player.rule: a falling edge queues a start only while idle (t27/rtl/fpga_trace_player.t27)

captures: four captures of the fixed player (three with 0x72, one with 0xff): PASS, 34 vectors, one run each, byte-identical
